headline: Fuel: New Rise from Refineries, Further Pressure at the Pump Before August 15
summary: Fuel prices are on a new upward path, with refinery increases already passing to the market. Brent crude stood at $88.7 per barrel, and further pump price pressure is expected before August 15.
why: Refinery margins and crude prices feed directly into retail fuel costs, which affect transport, inflation and consumer spending.
